notes: Archive checksums identify the files already present at Phase 0. They do not prove download origin or upstream version. Schemas describe source files, not cleaned data.

datasets.name: UCI Cleveland Heart Disease
datasets.download: Open original_url, select Download, and save the ZIP as data/raw/heart+disease.zip. Audit member processed.cleveland.data; do not use the other hospitals' files as a substitute.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (UCI dataset page); attribute the UCI dataset and original authors.
datasets.version: UCI dataset ID 45; source release/version within existing ZIP not independently verified
datasets.target: num (source values 0-4); Phase I preserves num and derives heart_disease_binary = 1 when num > 0
known_quality_concerns: Missing values encoded as '?' in source data
Small sample and historical clinical setting
ZIP includes other hospitals and unprocessed files; only processed.cleveland.data is registered

features.slope: Peak exercise ST segment slope code
features.ca: Number of major vessels seen by fluoroscopy

datasets.name: UCI Early Stage Diabetes Risk Prediction
datasets.download: Open original_url, select Download, and save the ZIP as data/raw/early+stage+diabetes+risk+prediction+dataset.zip. Required member: diabetes_data_upload.csv.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (UCI dataset page); attribute the UCI dataset and authors.
datasets.dataset_type: Real-world questionnaire classification data from Sylhet Diabetes Hospital, Bangladesh, per UCI
datasets.version: UCI dataset ID 529; source release/version within existing ZIP not independently verified
known_quality_concerns: UCI marks the dataset as having missing values; audit the downloaded file itself
Questionnaire symptoms may have selection and reporting bias

datasets.name: Healthcare Stroke Prediction
datasets.download: Sign in to Kaggle, open original_url, select Download, and place the ZIP at data/raw/archive.zip. Ensure it contains healthcare-dataset-stroke-data.csv. If Kaggle supplies a different archive name, rename only after recording its original filename and SHA-256 in the acquisition log.
datasets.license: Check the current Kaggle dataset page before redistribution. No license assertion is made from the local archive.
datasets.dataset_type: Tabular classification data; real-world origin and collection method not independently verified
datasets.records: unverified; do not assert real-world patient origin
datasets.version: Kaggle fedesoriano dataset; archive version/download date not recorded
known_quality_concerns: Source collection and patient provenance are unclear
smoking_status value 'Unknown' is an unavailable response, not a clinical category
id is an identifier, not a predictive feature

datasets.name: Synthea synthetic patients and encounters
datasets.download: On original_url, choose a CSV sample archive (100 or 1,000 patients), save it as data/raw/synthea.zip, and verify it contains csv/patients.csv and csv/encounters.csv. Record the exact sample link, generation date/version, and SHA-256 when re-acquiring.
datasets.license: Synthea download page states generated data may be used without restriction; cite Synthea as requested there. Verify code license separately if modifying the generator.
datasets.version: Unknown generator release and seed for existing archive; exact download URL unverified
known_quality_concerns: Generated records are not observed patient outcomes
One-to-many patient-to-encounter relationship; joins can duplicate patient rows
Synthetic names and addresses must still be treated carefully in demos

features.Id: Synthetic patient UUID and join key
